enchantments.tooltip: Constitution +4: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +4 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Lifesealed +17: You are immune to magical effects that cause instant death. In addition, you have a +17% enhancement bonus to Negative Energy Absorption.
Vitality +13: Passive: +13 Vitality bonus to Hit Points.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +16 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
